checks.description: Production receipt verifier plus canonical persisted binding rejects every modified identity, invented receipt and changed usage without ledger writes.
Known output with unknown price keeps the full cost reservation; same-key replay is stable, conflicting replay and fabricated zero price are rejected, and usage reconciliation publishes nothing.
A complete transport receipt may prove request completion without any usage; both reservations remain, the immutable receipt cannot be rewritten and reconciliation cannot invent zero.
A real SQLite reconciliation-insert fault preserves the complete transport receipt and atomically rolls back usage/spans; exact receipt repair settles once without replay or terminal publication.
Operator-style exact usage reconciliation is atomic with its idempotency receipt; failure leaves no partial update and successful replay remains a ledger-only action.

An actually exited local fixture child with a verified-stopped receipt cannot clear an unresolved remote request; production quiescence rejects, reservations and unknown claim survive factory rebuild, and no replay occurs.
